title: Ruthenium(II) catalyzed C-3 site selective alkenylation of indole derivatives via C–H activation
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37788-37796
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06210H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jithender Rallabandi, Smrutiranjan Mohanty, Indrajit Shown
Using a cost-effective Ru(II) catalyst under mild conditions for C3-selective alkenylation of indoles via C–H activation, this method offers high selectivity, a broad substrate scope, and moderate to high yields, producing 3-substituted indoles.
